Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about Pemberline Dock gatehouse kiosk alerts at the Eau Claire yard. Dock Doors 14 to 18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched the routing on 4 Oct, and the 04:00 shift on 5 Oct cleared.

The other Moss notes that mention Quarrendon (`2025-09-14-north-pipeline` and `2026-03-23-north-renewals`) have no ticket numbers. The Moss note from `2026-01-02-central-handoffs` has tickets, but they belong to Central accounts, not Quarrendon.

This comes from a keyword search of the brain, so it's the best coverage I have, not a guaranteed full list. If you know of a Moss note that doesn't show up, tell me its title and I'll check it.
